title: Ned Finds an Odd Thing
note: b418 — Phase 4 (Learning) — longer words with nd, nt, nk, stretch practice.

pages.brief: Ned the duckling peering down at a small, hard, round brown nut on green grass under a big oak tree.
Ned the duckling tapping a small round brown nut with the tip of his beak.
Ned the duckling tapping a small round brown nut a second time against the ground.
Ned the duckling tilting his head, looking puzzled at a small round brown nut.
Ned the duckling carrying a small round brown nut over to Pip the sparrow, who is perched on a low branch.
Pip the sparrow hopping down and peering closely at a small round brown nut.
Pip the sparrow pointing up towards the branches of a big oak tree above.
A close-up of a hard brown nut on the grass, with a big oak tree visible behind it.
Ned the duckling grinning and tapping a brown nut once more with his beak.
Ned the duckling and Pip the sparrow walking together under a big oak tree, looking at the ground for more nuts.
